Class OidcSignInHandler

java.lang.Object
org.jwcarman.who.oidc.OidcSignInHandler
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.springframework.security.web.authentication.AuthenticationFailureHandler, org.springframework.security.web.authentication.AuthenticationSuccessHandler
public final class OidcSignInHandler extends Object implements org.springframework.security.web.authentication.AuthenticationSuccessHandler, org.springframework.security.web.authentication.AuthenticationFailureHandler
Turns a provider sign-in into a who session, or into a pending sign-up for an account who does not know. A provider sign-in links only when it answers POST /who/oidc/link/{id}: a plain one by someone already signed in never offers to. Spring Security's own token never reaches the session: the security context is cleared after every outcome.

      public OidcSignInHandler(SignInRegistrations registrations, WhoService whoService, FederatedCredentialRepository credentials, WhoSessionSecurityContextRepository sessions, org.springframework.security.web.authentication.session.SessionAuthenticationStrategy sessionStrategy, PendingSignUps pendingSignUps, OidcRedirects redirects, WhoEventPublisher eventPublisher, LastSignInCookie lastSignInCookie, Clock clock, Duration signUpWindow, Duration linkWindow)
      Creates the handler.
      Parameters:
      registrations - the registrations who signs in with
      whoService - resolves a credential to its identity
      credentials - finds the credential for an issuer and subject
      sessions - stores the who session
      sessionStrategy - the chain's session fixation protection and CSRF rotation
      pendingSignUps - keeps pending sign-ups in the session
      redirects - where the browser goes afterwards
      eventPublisher - where sign-in events are published
      lastSignInCookie - remembers the provider used, or null when turned off
      clock - stamps events and expiries
      signUpWindow - how long a pending sign-up lasts
      linkWindow - how long a started link lasts
